findings.trigger: After all networks removed, reselecting the currency could leave empty network and produce a valid signature, enabling a POST with implicit backend default network.
findings.impact: Withdrawn route could still progress to order creation instead of requiring an available explicit network.
findings.resolution: Known offerings with empty networks return null route signature; their currency options are disabled. Reset currency and captured callback guards reject the route.
findings.verification: Final diff independently inspected; primary owns targeted behavioral and browser regression receipts.

assessment: Validated unique currency/network option shapes are rendered with DOM option.textContent, avoiding interpolation. Same-route refresh preserves existing currency/network/address/tag/no_tag exactly without localStorage restore or addressbook reload.

Removed route or changed tag_name/tag_kind/tag_sep requires explicit re-selection, clears recipient data for known prior metadata, and retires pending addressbook requests/chips. First sole-network metadata hydration preserves in-progress address input.
Explicit route changes reset memo/no_tag, restore only route-keyed saved address, and tolerate storage read failure. Empty/removed networks cannot silently default after metadata is known.

Captured Buy route marker includes currency/network/tag contract and callback identity; refreshed offerings invalidate only the currently matching Buy review, while captured callback independently checks signature before submit. Other review flows are unaffected.
All bytes outside the declared state/helper and four-function scope are unchanged; loadRates, shared review machinery, both submit payloads and backend unchanged.
Read-only production preflight passed with 56 live inputs and 4 unchanged services. Fourteen local scope/drift/atomic apply/reconcile/rollback checks passed.
